faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial featuring up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your card is linked during signup and only charged after the trial finishes unless cancelled.

faq.q: Do Ceyo bots continue working during local power cuts or internet outages?
faq.a: Yes. Each bot operates in its own secure, isolated cloud computer that runs 24/7 regardless of your local connectivity. Even if your phone is turned off or your power drops, scheduled browser routines and coding tasks continue seamlessly.

faq.q: Can I manage my bots through Telegram in The Gambia?
faq.a: Yes, Ceyo natively integrates with Telegram. You can chat with individual specialized agents, trigger autonomous browser tasks, or invite multiple bots into Telegram group chats where they collaborate as a unified team.

faq.q: What languages do Ceyo AI agents understand?
faq.a: Ceyo agents process standard English natively and can translate or communicate in major regional languages including Wolof, French, and Arabic. They can draft messages, analyze web pages, or converse in multiple languages simultaneously.

faq.q: What kind of autonomous tasks can the browser bot perform?
faq.a: The built-in autonomous browser opens websites, fills out online forms, conducts deep market research, and compares supplier pricing. It extracts data into spreadsheets and documents without requiring manual oversight.
